senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to move,] to throw, swing. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 2 (ref. to Ex. XV, 1 a.
units: 4) ר׳ שהיו עולין למרום וכ׳ ramah means that they were hurled upward, yarah, that they were thrown down the deep.

senses.gloss: to impose upon, deceive; to be cunning. Y. Hor. III, 48ᵃ bot. (he was no deceiver) אלא שהיה מְרַמֶּה במצות but he was cunning in charitable deeds (waited until others had subscribed, and then gave as much as all of them combined); Deut. R. s. 4; Tanḥ. R’eh 5.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> <he>אתה רִמִּיתָ באביך בגדי … שתמר מְרַמָּה בך וכ׳</he> thou (Judah) didst deceive thy father by means of a kid (<cite ref="Genesis 37:31">Gen. XXXVII, 31</cite>); by thy life! Tamar shall deceive thee through a kid (ib. XXXVIII, 20); Yalk. ib. 145 <he>לאביך … לך</he>; a. e.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M02593"><he>מְרוּמֶּה</he></cite>.
